module: Part of the third-party LuaIRC library. Module "irc.set": a set of IRC connections monitored together with socket.select. Allows managing several clients and processing only those that have data to read.
notes: In set:remove, self.connections is indexed both by socket and by position; removal by position (remove(self.connections, k)) assumes that sockets and connections remain aligned.
The object passed to new can define a timeout field, used by select.

new.desc: Turns the table t into a set (connections and sockets fields created empty, set metatable).

add.desc: Adds a connection (its socket is added to the monitored list).

connection.desc: IRC connection with a socket field

remove.desc: Removes a connection from the set.

select.desc: Calls socket.select on the sockets with self.timeout and returns the list of connections ready to read.

poll.desc: Like select, but on timeout returns all the connections (so that they can do their periodic work).
